# FFmpeg Batch Script Toolkit (Windows Batch Version)

**(Generated by ChatGPT and may contain inaccuracies)**

[English](readme_en.md) | [中文](../README.md) | [繁體中文](readme_tcn.md)

This is an enhanced FFmpeg batch-processing toolkit.
The original all-in-one script has been **split into four modular scripts**, making the structure cleaner, easier to maintain, and more flexible for updates and expansion.

The new architecture uses **main.bat as the central menu**, which calls three separate functional scripts stored inside the `batch-files/` folder.

---

## 📌 Major Update at 2025-11-19

### ✔️ **The original single large script has been split into four independent functional scripts:**

| Script File              | Function                                                                                 |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **main.bat**             | Main menu launcher; dispatches all sub-scripts                                           |
| **encode.bat**           | Batch video transcoding (H.264 / HEVC / AV1 with full hardware acceleration support)     |
| **mp4_to_gif.bat**       | Batch MP4 → GIF converter (resolution & FPS configurable)                                |
| **extract_separate.bat** | Extract video-only stream + extract all audio tracks with correct codec-based extensions |

### ✔️ Benefits

* **Clear modular architecture**
* **Each function operates independently**
* **Cleaner menu for better user experience**
* **Automatic multi-audio detection & correct file extension matching**
* **All scripts batch-process files in the `input/` directory**

---

## ✨ Feature Overview (Based on the New 4-Script Structure)

### 1️⃣ `encode.bat` – Video Transcoding Module

* Supports: H.264 / HEVC (H.265) / AV1
* **Decoding methods:** CPU, NVIDIA CUVID, Intel QSV, AMD AMF
* **Encoding methods:** CPU, NVENC, QSV, AMF
* Selectable **profiles:** main / high / high10 / main10
* Optional resolution scaling (scale filter)
* Full bitrate control (b:v / maxrate / bufsize)
* Audio: copy, ignore, or custom encoding
* Subtitle: copy, remove, or custom settings
* Automatically processes files in the input folder

---

### 2️⃣ `mp4_to_gif.bat` – MP4 → GIF Converter

* Custom resolution (recommended to keep small)
* Configurable FPS (10–15 recommended)
* Batch conversion of the input directory
* Outputs GIF files into the output folder

---

### 3️⃣ `extract_separate.bat` – Video/Audio Extraction (Major Upgrade)

* Extract **video-only** stream (no audio, lossless copy)
* Detects **all audio tracks**
* Automatically matches correct audio extension
  (m4a / mp3 / ogg / flac / dts / ac3 / etc.)
* Outputs audio files as:

```
filename-audio1.m4a
filename-audio2.ac3
filename-audio3.opus
...
```

* Outputs the video-only file as:

```
filename-video-only.mp4
```

---

### 4️⃣ `main.bat` – Central Control Menu (Rebuilt)

* Unified entry point
* Calls encode / mp4_to_gif / extract_separate scripts
* Clean interface and easy to expand

---

## 📁 Directory Structure

```
Project/
│
├── main.bat                  # Main menu
│
├── batch-files/              # Functional scripts
│   ├── encode.bat            # Video transcoding
│   ├── mp4_to_gif.bat        # MP4 → GIF
│   └── extract_separate.bat  # Video/audio extraction
│
├── input/                    # Input folder
│   └── .gitkeep
│
├── output/                   # Output for transcoded videos / GIFs / video-only streams
│
└── audio-out/                # Audio extraction output (created automatically)
```

---

## 📘 How to Use

### 1. Place video/audio files into `input/`

Supports any common media format (mp4 / mkv / mov / flac / mp3 / m4a ...).
`.gitkeep` is ignored automatically.

---

### 2. Run `main.bat`

Choose an option:

| Option | Script                                                   |
| ------ | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1      | Video transcoding (encode.bat)                           |
| 2      | MP4 to GIF conversion (mp4_to_gif.bat)                   |
| 3      | Extract video-only + audio tracks (extract_separate.bat) |

---

### 3. Configure settings as prompted

Resolution, bitrate, profile, encoder, FPS, etc.

---

### 4. Start processing

Outputs are stored in:

* `output/`
* `audio-out/` (for audio extraction)

---

## ⚠️ Notes

1. **Hardware acceleration requires proper GPU driver support.**
2. CPU-based encoding is most compatible but slower.
3. GIF files tend to be large—use smaller resolution and lower FPS if possible.
4. For viewing file details, MediaInfo is recommended.

---
